name: Ontology item GA
description: General availability of the Microsoft Fabric IQ Ontology item enables teams to maintain a shared model of business entities, properties, and relationships in Fabric. Modelers can connect those definitions to supported data sources and provide business context to supported analytics and agent experiences. The release covers the ontology item and its supported capabilities; individual integrations, security features, and advanced modeling capabilities retain their own release milestones.

result.descriptionEs: La disponibilidad general del elemento Ontology de Fabric IQ permite mantener un modelo compartido de entidades, propiedades y relaciones de negocio, conectarlo a orígenes de datos compatibles y dar contexto de negocio a la analítica y a los agentes. Cada integración, función de seguridad o capacidad avanzada tiene su propio calendario.
